name: Anthesteria
summary: The flowers of Dionysus and the oldest of his feasts: Jar-Opening, Wine-Jugs and Pots — the new wine broached, each drinker silent at a table of his own, and the dead abroad in the city until told to leave.
testimonia: Thucydides 2.15.4 ("the older Dionysia... on the twelfth of Anthesterion")
